caveat: When operated in FIPS mode with the tamper evident seals installed as indicated in the Security Policy and configured according to the Entropy Token Section of the Security Policy. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy. There is no assurance of the minimum strength of generated keys
level_exceptions: Cryptographic Module Ports and Interfaces: Level 3
description: The FortiMail family of email security appliances provide an effective barrier against the ever-rising volume of sophisticated spam and malware and includes features designed to facilitate regulatory compliance. FortiMail 5.2 offers both inbound and outbound scanning, advanced antispam and antivirus filtering capabilities, malware emulation both locally and via integration with FortiSandbox, data leak prevention, identity based encryption and extensive quarantine and archiving capabilities.
